ranges.exactText: **Evidence inventory update (2026-10-13):** An audit of 95 run directories found zero owner-adjudicated gold units and no unexposed, ready-to-use holdout. Run59 was already called despite `holdoutOpenedAt: null`; treat it as exposed development evidence. Run58–65 contain useful retrieval/selection diagnostics, but repeated language arms and queries on the same source/project do not increase the independent sample size. Do not promote their provider scores as calibrated confidence. A new confirmatory set requires owner-adjudicated, frozen source/query/facet labels from project families not used in prior runs; adjudicate before any Jev call.

**Next gate:** adjudicate the disputed Run65 spans and build a frozen project-grouped cohort with at least 30 independent labeled units; investigate the separate MSSR registry failure. Report retrieval, selection, sufficiency, overbreadth, abstention, and exact evidence integrity separately, and preserve human review before canonical writes. Detailed history remains in the [experiment ledger](../experiments/jev-mssr-live/README.md) and [benchmark history](knowledge/reference/mssr-jev-confidence-run-history.md).
